Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Payments (Demo) team.

Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 5 days left in the sprint.
Daniel, please share your update. What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, and there’s nothing blocking you.

task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, is past its due date. What is the new date?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: the reconciliation report is at risk, you’ll start it right after the idempotency keys, and you’ll flag it if it slips.

Daniel, story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Daniel, for the summary page being on hold until the idempotency keys are in, who can help unblock this?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
Thanks, Daniel. Maya, please share your update: what you finished, what’s next, and whether anything is blocking you.

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline, I will add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 where the sandbox gateway keeps timing out and you need access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and commitment: the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review and you’ll chase them today, and the blocker will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.
Admin, what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday, I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted that yesterday you finished the refund API tests, today you’re working on the payment retry story, and there are no blockers.

Task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Admin, for task 14 being delayed because the sandbox was down and you plan to finish it tomorrow, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker: Waiting on the sandbox with the platform team, and it will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers were raised: the summary page remains on track and will resume after idempotency keys, settlement validation is blocked on bug 12 with sandbox gateway timeouts and staging access, PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review, and work was delayed by the sandbox being down while waiting on the platform team. A side discussion between Daniel Park and Admin about gateway timeouts was parked for offline follow-up. task 15 is stale and wasn’t covered, and the owners will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who did not respond, are coming in Teams—thanks, everyone.
